title: fix(plugin-grid): row menu hides Edit on a row held by a locking approval
body:
Fixes #36911
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在列表页和记录页的关联页签里，对正在审批且被锁定的记录打开行菜单时，不再看到「编辑」，「删除」照旧保留。
- 属于记录页关联列表体验的修补，替用户省掉「点了编辑才被告知已锁定」这一步。
- 出错的话，最坏是锁定行的「编辑」仍然出现，点了会和以前一样弹出拒绝提示；改动可以直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The grid's row menu (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`) now follows the approval lock the grid's select-first cells already read. Both the list page and a record page's related tab (the related list's enlarged face, which renders `object-grid`) draw this menu, so both change together.

- **The read.** It reuses the existing `useRowApprovalLocks` hook (`POST /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/locks`), which is not exported, and its rule `resolveApprovalLock`. Nothing is copied. The read is made once for the rows on screen, when a row's actions are first reached for: the existing `onActionsDemand` channel (pointer or focus on the actions cell, the "⋮" opening, the row context menu, the page bar's single-row menu). It is never made on first paint (the objectstack#35795 posture). The hook now also runs on a grid whose rows offer Edit, not only on a select-first grid. It still reads nothing until it is asked.
- **The verdict.** A row whose lock read answered `locked: true` offers no Edit. That matches the record page, which draws no Edit on an approval-locked record (objectstack#35593). Delete stays for a record held by its own approval, because the server lets such a record be deleted and cancels its request (#13568). The batch read answers only for that case. A line held because its master is held refuses delete too, so if #37041 makes the read report such lines, the read must tell the two apart before this menu uses it.
- **Hidden, not disabled.** Hidden follows the record page (objectstack#35593) and the row menu's own record-verdict posture (#4296). The disabled-with-reason alternative was not taken.
- **Only an answered lock counts.** The row is handed to the hook without its `approval_status` column, so the column does not stand in for a read. In each of these cases the menu stays as it was: a 501 (no approvals service), a `null` entry (a row the reader cannot read), a failed read, or a read not yet asked. The select-first cells keep their column fallback unchanged.

Files: `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` (hook gate and `demandRowActions`), `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx` (Edit verdict and demand wiring), and the new test `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`. `RowActionMenu.tsx` and `useRowApprovalLocks.ts` are unchanged.

### The reading this card asked for (served state)

Tree: objectstack-ai/objectstack at 8e4ac50d (re-read at 1e96009a).

- **Declared per-row predicates** (`userActions.edit` / `delete` `visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen`): already served, and already followed by both related-list faces.
- **The master's approval lock on its master-detail lines:** already followed. The record page withholds New, Edit and Delete on those lists (`withDetailWritesWithheld`, objectstack#35599 ruling A).
- **The row's own approval lock:** served by the batch door. Before this PR the list page's row menu read none of it; the lock reached only the cells. This PR makes the row menu follow it.
- **Package-hook refusals** (the HotCRM measured case): nothing serves them. The seat ruled for no Feature card. An app that wants the row menu to know declares the rule on the child object's `userActions` predicates. The toast from #36885 covers refusals after the fact.

## Tests

- New file `rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`, 7 pins. Five come from the first round: a locked row offers no Edit and keeps Delete, while its unlocked sibling keeps Edit; no lock read before a row's actions are reached for, then one read for the page and none on repeat; a 501 over an `approval_status: pending` row leaves the menu as it was; a `null` entry leaves Edit; a failed or not-yet-asked read leaves Edit. Two were added in fix round 1. **List page:** on the list page, a row's actions come from the single-row selection bar (`SelectionBar.tsx`), not a ⋮ column. With the locked row selected, the bar offers no Edit and still offers Delete; with its unlocked sibling selected, the bar offers Edit, which is the control. The bar already read the lock before this round, because it resolves its actions from the same `rowActionMenuProps` and asks through the same `onActionsDemand` on mount. No wiring was added; only the pin is new. **Read in flight:** the lock answer is held, the ⋮ menu is opened and Edit shows; the answer is released and Edit leaves the open menu while Delete stays. Result at 4c64a0a1: 7/7 passed.
- Ablation, run once and not kept: `canEdit && rowOps?.update !== false && !approvalLockAnswered(row),` was replaced by `canEdit && rowOps?.update !== false,` through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The mutation was confirmed on disk (anchor count 1 to 0, blob 2c0f37ef to dc3f8dc5). The first pin turned red as predicted (Tests 1 failed, 4 passed). After the restore, the blob matched HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. In fix round 1, the same ablation was run at 4c64a0a1 (blob c420482d to 2f180f3e) and turned 3 pins red: the ⋮ pin, the list-page bar pin and the in-flight pin (Tests 3 failed, 4 passed; the bar pin received `{ edit: true, delete: true }`). A second ablation changed `approvalLocks.isLocked(rowRecordId(row), null)` to `approvalLocks.isLocked(rowRecordId(row), row)`, which lets the `approval_status` column stand in (blob c420482d to be48f357). It turned the 501-over-pending-column pin red (Tests 1 failed, 6 passed; received `{ edit: false, delete: true }`). Both restores were confirmed: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- Stale fixtures fixed in this PR. Two existing explain-engine fakes (`rowRecordCrudVerdict.test.tsx`, `inlineEditRecordVerdict-27365.test.tsx`) answered every URL as the explain engine. Once reaching a row's actions also read the lock door, they counted that read as an explain call: 19 tests red on the first full run. Each fake now answers the lock door "unlocked" and leaves it out of its call count. Their assertions are unchanged.

Fix round 1 readings, at head `4c64a0a1`: the full plugin-grid suite gave `Test Files 312 passed (312) · Tests 2773 passed (2773)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` gave 172 passed and 2 skipped files, 5130 passed and 2 skipped tests, exit 0. The 39 derived gate families all exited 0. One of them, `check:type-check-debt`, first hit a queue timeout (exit 3, not measured) and then exited 0 on a re-run. Reconciliation with `--ran` gave 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. overlap-check exited 0 and merges cleanly with origin/main and with #37084.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not covered: the compact related-list face and the phone gallery.** The compact face is the `components` data-table (`DataTableBuiltinRowActionItem`). Neither can reach the grid's lock hook without a new dependency or export. No card is filed for this, per the seat's ruling. On those surfaces Edit on a locked row stays until it is refused, and the #36885 toast explains the refusal.
- **Detail lines read "not locked".** The batch lock door reports detail lines of a locked master as not locked until #37041 lands. Its single-record sibling reports them as locked. On a record page those lines are already withheld (objectstack#35599), but on a detail object's own list page their Edit stays until #37041.
- **Edit is not held inert while the read is on the wire.** A click that lands before the answer opens the form as before, and the server's refusal is shown by the existing toast. The in-flight pin above fixes this behaviour.
- **Note only: every row locked.** When every row on screen is locked and Delete is not offered (a predicate or a grant withholds it), the ⋮ column is not drawn. The record-grained verdict already behaves this way.
- **Deliberate: 501 with a pending column.** On a 501, a row whose `approval_status` column reads pending is read-only in its cells (the cells use the column fallback), while its menu still offers Edit (the menu uses answered locks only).
- **Possible follow-up, inherited: stale answers.** Lock answers can go stale while the grid stays mounted. The hook drops them only when the object's data is invalidated.
- **Pre-existing: other edit paths.** Staged click-to-edit and the bulk Change owner action do not read the lock.

## Verification

Read first (riskiest first):
1. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/objectGridActionsColumn.tsx`: `approvalLockAnswered` and the `canEdit` expression in `rowCrudVerdicts`, the one verdict both the column's draw decision and every menu read.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: the `useRowApprovalLocks` gate and `demandRowActions`, which together decide when the read is made.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowMenuApprovalLock-36911.test.tsx`. Expect 7 passed.
